notes.title: New game announcement!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-VS-HtpWFjs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Go to the forest to collect as many mushrooms as possible! Will you be able to fill your basket to the brim? Develop your attentiveness, collect a variety of mushrooms and compete for the title of the best mushroom picker.
Take a break from the hustle and bustle of the city by walking through a picturesque forest. Enjoy nature, pick mushrooms and immerse yourself in the atmosphere of tranquility.
Forest paths hide many secrets. Explore every corner, find rare species of mushrooms and become a true connoisseur of mycology!
GAME FEATURES

Explore seven different locations with their unique places and vegetation, varied weather and mushroom picking conditions.

The game features 32 popular types of mushrooms with their own growing areas. Each mushroom has several stages of growth, its own unique quality level and weight.

Complete various tasks, participate in festivals and mushroom picking competitions.

Upgrade your basket and knife to collect more mushrooms and get more experience and coins.

[b]The release is scheduled for Q4 2025. Add the game to your wishlist to stay up to date with the release and game news![/b]
